name: The Sheperd's Transit
description:
Shepherd's Transit is the introductory scenario to the game Outside the Wire. The scenario is designed to introduce key elements of pressure, restraint, campaign consequences and skirmish rules. This scenario is rules lite - not the full set to allow quick play. GMs can determine information (e.g., the range modifiers, cover, etc.) for Die Roll Modifiers (DRMs).

The scenario provides solo play with a base oracle, control sheet, and a flow sheet. The oracle is used to answer yes-or-no questions. The control sheet provides a sheet to track key solo decisions. The flow sheet is designed to provide solo players with a map of events and resolutions to help them learn the game's core concepts.

While GMs are welcome to use the flow chart, they are able to adapt the scenario to the goals of the table when combined with the regional description.

The sunlight dial and Enemy AI chart provide a means to introduce pressure into decision making.

There is a single encounter table provided as a means to introduce civilian dilemmas.

This game is about pressure, not victory. You are not here to defeat the enemy. You are here to manage instability under constraint. Your authority is limited. Your information is incomplete.

Outside the Wire is a solo and GM-driven modern military RPG about pressure, consequence, and survival.

  • Playable solo or with a GM

  • Combat is fast, lethal, and consequential

  • Campaign pressure persists between missions

  • Quiet success is real success
